notes: Topline: massive-scale search for compliance + discovery (legal, risk).
Scale: target 300M -> 1.2B vectors in 12-18 months; current POC load ~450M doc equivalents planned.
Architecture preference: two-tier retrieval: lightweight ANN for recall, then bi-encoder + cross-encoder rerank on top-K.
Performance SLOs: median query latency (retrieval + rerank) <80ms; p95 <200ms for standard queries; some SLA classes need <100ms p99.
Cost sensitivity: strict — "cannot exceed $0.015 / user-search" averaged across rerank stages (prospect quote).
Ingest profile: bulk historical reindex (~60% of corpus up-front), steady-state incremental ~2M vectors/day.
Embedding dims: exploring 1536 and 3072 dims depending on model quality vs cost; open to quantized variants.
Caching interest: aggressive prefix + hot-query cache to avoid repeated rerank costs; want smart hot-key routing.
Batching: seeking optimal batch sizes for embeddings generation (throughput vs GPU memory) — POC measuring 128/256/512 windows.
Fallbacks: want auto-fallback to quantized 8-bit models when Dedicated burst capacity exceeded; prefer routing policy control.
Compliance notes: data residency required in us-east & eu-west; retention controls for logs/queries required for audit.
Quote: 'If we can't get predictable $/query at scale, we'll build a hybrid stack. Need your numbers.' — Head of Search (L. Moreno)
Drive assets: pricing + comparison deck requested (drive link in linked_drive_docs).
Gmail: several threads include legal questions and drive attachments (thread ids listed).
POC metrics so far: embedding throughput 20k/s on sample worker, ANN recall 0.92 at k=100, rerank latency per-doc ~6ms on t4/rtx benchmarks (needs tuning).
technical_summary: Evaluating Redwood Dedicated/Private for a three-stage RAG pipeline at 300M-1B vectors. Key requirements: fast ANN retrieval, low-latency cross-encoder rerank at scale, batching/caching to reduce per-query unit cost, KMS integration, audit logs, and region residency. Want kernel/quantization recommendations and autoscaling policy for burst windows.
deployment_notes: Prefers private control plane with customer-managed networking; on-prem air-gapped possible for specific regulated sub-corp. Must support HSM-backed key management and allow pinning to quantized model variants for cost control.
poC_success_criteria: Sustain ingest of 2M vectors/day for 30 days without degradation
